data.title: 陈千语 · 茶叶沉下去的时候
data.description: 茶台边，千语一手扶住壶盖，一手缓缓倾斜茶壶。热茶穿过小滤网落进杯子，她这次特意放慢了动作。
data.promptProse: In a quiet wooden tea room, Chen Qianyu wears a forest-green linen blouse and cream trousers. She pours tea through a small strainer into a cup, steadying the teapot lid with her other hand. Window light falls across the tea table and her dark hair.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the teapot handle and the other keeps its lid in place above the strainer.
data.action: 扶稳壶盖，把茶缓缓倒过小滤网
